Medial horizontal tear is definite; lateral meniscal contusion without definite tear is uncertain. Broad unqualified osteochondral-defect absence supports cartilage negatives. Effusion lacks severity; Baker absence is explicit. Meniscal contusion is not bone contusion, so the bone-contusion target is unmentioned.
